beacon-stair.where: The Tinderwick Beacon — all three floors of the wick-key ascent to the lantern room
beacon-stair.mood: The Beacon Stair — a bass that climbs a step every bar, a determined call, brass like banked embers and a bell glinting from the lamp far above.

bell-cellar.where: The Bell Cellar (the flooded cellars and the drowned belfry pit under Lowtinder's lamp-house, where the old town bell lies in black water; a rope climbs the old shaft to Tinderwick's well)
bell-cellar.mood: A flooded stone cellar under the sea: dripping water, black still pools, and somewhere a huge old bell humming when the tide turns. Hushed, patient and a little sad, never horror.

cinderhead-mine-a.where: Cinderhead Mine (the lamplit mine-mouth town of the Lamp-down vigil)
cinderhead-mine-a.mood: Ink-black galleries where crystal veins and lamp-fire are the only light — a slow miners' hymn, melancholy but faintly warm.

cinderhead-mine-b.where: Cinderhead Lumenary (Otho Grist's hall at the mine mouth — the difficulty wall)
cinderhead-mine-b.mood: The mine under pressure — groaning timbers, charged air, a terse staccato motif over a driving low walk; held-breath tension before the wall.

cinderhead-mine-c.where: Cinderhead Deep (the three descent galleries to the old crew's vigil-lamp)
cinderhead-mine-c.mood: The deep galleries where dense crystal turns the dark luminous — a sparkle-led descent, minor warming to its relative major.

cinderwind-ashfall.where: The Ashfall Shelf (cinderwind_ashfall): the main-path route between Cinderwind Scarp and Galehigh — a high grey shelf of century-old slag tips, ash-grass in the wind, the haulers' camp brazier, the old kiln stack on the cliff
cinderwind-ashfall.mood: Daylight after three caves: wide, windswept and a little melancholy, warmed by a brazier; grey ash-grass, coal-smoke and open sky, the climb nearly done.

coldfog-marches-a.where: The Coldfog cluster — the drained marches, the snuffed beacon and the Murkfall vigil site
coldfog-marches-a.mood: Snuffed — a drained marsh where the lanterns went out; a lone melody that keeps reaching for home and guttering before it gets there.

coldopen-foreboding.where: The cold-open cinematic (the Long Dusk falls; a star winks out)
coldopen-foreboding.mood: The Long Dusk falling: hushed foreboding under a sky losing its lanterns, a fragile hopeful phrase that reaches up and is never answered.

dawn-breaks.where: The ending cinematic (dawn breaks over Vesperholm)
dawn-breaks.mood: The long night ends: first light walking across every valley; the hometown lullaby finally meets the sun, radiant and tender.

dawnstead-a.where: Dawnstead — the epilogue town in the first true daylight (and the post-game festival/Còr scenes there)
dawnstead-a.mood: The lullaby in full — the hometown theme finally meeting the sun, radiant, confident and a little teary.

dimglass-coast-a.where: Dimglass Coast (the first road out of town, both crossings)
dimglass-coast-a.mood: The road that teaches you to wander — brisk, salt-aired, optimistic; the hometown tune breaking into a stride.

dimglass-coast-b.where: Wrackline Path and Lanternfall Road — the coastal road between Pearlmoor and the Vesper Crossroads, either side of the Sounding Cave
dimglass-coast-b.mood: Salt wind, last light — the coast road's pensive sibling: a longer, lonelier walk at dusk with the sea going dark beside you.

dimglass-coast-c.where: Tideglass Cavern & Gallery, the Sounding Cave on the coast road, and the Lanternway Under-Lane
dimglass-coast-c.mood: Buoy-light drift — a becalmed, glittering sea-cave; the coast road's tune reduced to a glint over dripping water.

driftholm.where: Driftholm, the island town of the Farlamp Isles, cut off in the long dark for eleven winters
driftholm.mood: A sea-town hymn in the long dark: warm but lonely, small lamps kept alone in the windows.

driftholm-dawn.where: Driftholm after the isles' dawn: the fog lifted, boats out, the town awake in daylight
driftholm-dawn.mood: The same island hymn turned major and full: a town that has its morning back.

duskapple-orchard.where: Duskapple Orchard — Tinderwick's old orchard through the west hedge, from the first visit until the first Gleam is relit (the fallen-star crater)
duskapple-orchard.mood: The Fallen Star — the hometown lullaby gone cold in C minor, slowed to half time among charred boughs; a distant bell for the strike, and a cinder that still glows.

ending-credits.mood: The Road Remembered: a warm medley walking back down the whole journey in memory, every road leading home to the hometown theme in daylight.

farlamp-relit.where: The Drowned Lamp, the moment the Farlamp burns again and the Farlamp Isles get their own dawn
farlamp-relit.mood: The relight: the isles' hymn heard in the dark's minor, then blooming into warm major as the fog lifts.

farlamp-sound.where: Farlamp Sound, the Shelfwater and the Fogwall: rowing a small lamp-boat over the open deep sea towards a far blinking lamp
farlamp-sound.mood: Rowing on a long swell in the fog: the isles' hymn as a lone line over the sea.

galehigh-terraces-a.where: Galehigh Terraces (the kite-strung cliff town outdoors + the Skyloft; returns after the Kite-rising)
galehigh-terraces-a.mood: Updraft — giddy, wind-buffeted propulsion on the cliff-farms, kites snapping overhead in the last fire-light before the climb.

galehigh-terraces-b.where: Galehigh's Storm Lumenary hall (and the Kite-rising beat on the terraces)
galehigh-terraces-b.mood: Lanterns on the Wind — the windy cliff seen from inside the warm farmstead at dusk: cosy, a touch wistful, the wind a sigh at the shutters.

gleam-emotional.where: Every Gleam payoff — the moment a constellation relights and the town begins to celebrate (and the dawn)
gleam-emotional.mood: Belonging, not a trophy: the motif heard in the long dusk's minor, then blooming into warm major as the sky answers.

gleam-fanfare.where: The Gleam moment — a constellation relit (played as a sting by the cutscene's gleam op)
gleam-fanfare.mood: A lantern lifted to the sky: a short triumphant fanfare that quotes the hometown motif and lands firmly home.

hushfrost-pass-a.where: Hushfrost Pass I & II (the frozen canyon route west) + the Aurora Hollow spur
hushfrost-pass-a.mood: Lamp in the Canyon — a lone lamp in a frozen canyon, the cold at your back: sparse and tender enough to keep walking, hope holding on.

inn-rest.where: Every inn and rest point — the Vesper Crossroads Inn, the Pearlmoor Quayside Inn, the Lowleaf Guest-bower, Galehigh's Steady Gust, the Pale Vault's Held Flame and Nightreach's Long Watch
inn-rest.mood: Rest a while — a fire's glow, a full kettle and a warm bed; the hometown tune settled into a contented waltz.

interior-hearth.where: Happy family homes — first Galehigh's Terrace Cottage; the stock warm-home interior
interior-hearth.mood: Kettle on, a cat by the stove — a bright, bouncing little home tune for rooms where folk are glad you came.

interior-hush.where: Stock interior (tender worry and grief at home) — first heard in the apprentice's house in Tinderwick after the omen, before the first Gleam
interior-hush.mood: The Quiet After — the hometown lullaby played softly in a frightened house; the fire still lit, a music box that keeps trying to rise.

interior-lamplit.where: Everyday houses — first Pale Vault's Glacier Cottage; the stock neutral home interior
interior-lamplit.mood: Lamplit rooms — an unhurried, conversational little tune that sits under a chat by the stove and never asks for attention.

interior-study.where: Stock interior (thoughtful rooms: workshops, studies, star-chart cottages) — first heard in Nightreach's Watcher's Cottage
interior-study.mood: Charts and Lenses — a ticking, curious little room of ground glass and inked stars, gently absorbed in its work.

interior-sunny.where: Playful houses — Georgina's cottage (the Sunniest House in the Dark) and the Lifting House on Pearlmoor Quay
interior-sunny.mood: Sunny rooms with a wink — a sprightly, cheeky little ocarina tune that skips about the furniture.

interior-unease.where: Stock interior (rooms where something is wrong; Hollowing-touched places) — first heard in Hollowfen Stillworks, Coldfog Marches
interior-unease.mood: Cold Hearth — glass tones and a music box winding down in a room the warmth has left; eerie, beautiful, and strangely gentle.

lanternway-a.where: The Lanternway — the four lit country lanes between the rim towns and the Vesper Crossroads
lanternway-a.mood: The Walking Tune — the safe road home: a strolling shuffle of flute and reed, walking pizzicato and brushes, lamplight glinting on every post.

lowleaf-hollow-a.where: Lowleaf Hollow (the glowmoss forest town) and Gloamwood Dell
lowleaf-hollow-a.mood: A dim-green glowmoss forest where every dewdrop catches cyan light — Lydian wonder, enchanted and curious.

lowleaf-hollow-b.where: Lowleaf's Verdant Lumenary hall; also the Pearlmoor Wanderwood and the Glowmoss bloom beats in Lowleaf Hollow
lowleaf-hollow-b.mood: The safe glow at the heart of the dark forest — a lantern-lit music-box lullaby in a gentle waltz; hearth over wonder.

lowleaf-hollow-c.where: Glowmoss Deep (and its B1F), the Spore Grotto and the Grovefall vigil site
lowleaf-hollow-c.mood: The glowing-dark deep forest — a glassy bell melody whose echoes answer across the black, sparse and cathedral-like, with a drained grey shadow in it.

lowtinder.where: Lowtinder and Tinderwick Bay (the drowned old Tinderwick under the bay, swum to with Tidecall; half-sunk roofs, a cold bell-tower, one warm window: Gran Tallow's lamp-house) + the lamp-school's moss-garden
lowtinder.mood: The hometown lullaby, drowned: the same tune heard from under forty years of quiet sea. Cosy-melancholy, tender, a little haunted but never frightening; a music-box in an upstairs window.

lumenary-hall.where: Lumenary halls — the Tinderwick Lumenary (Brisa) and the Pearlmoor Lumenary (Reyl), and any later Lampwarden's hall without its own cue
lumenary-hall.mood: The hush before the duel — a stately processional between lamp-lit pillars, organ and choir in cool stone, walking toward the warden who will test you.

mirelight.where: The Mirelights (the Glassmere: a drowned causeway-field of wandering false blue lights over a still mere)
mirelight.mood: Eerie but tender: false blue lights drifting over still water, the echoes of a lost kin-light that once led travellers home.

nightreach-observatory-a.where: Nightreach Observatory (the star-temple town, last Lumenary, densest starfield in the game)
nightreach-observatory-a.mood: Under the Whole Sky: vast, lonely, wondrous - a single voice under every star, faint telescope clockwork, minor lifting toward major like hope dawning.

nightreach-observatory-b.mood: The Haunted Lumenary: the loneliest room in Vesperholm - a minor lullaby that reaches up and never quite comes home, a clock running down; hope present but not yet earned.

old-seams.where: The Old Seams (the sealed deep galleries under Cinderhead: plank bridges, ore-cart rails, the first fallen star asleep below)
old-seams.mood: Abandoned deep galleries: rails and dripping water in the dark, and something vast breathing slowly far below.

oldlight-f1.where: The Old Light, floor 1 — The Lobby of Groaners (Pearlmoor's joke-tower)
oldlight-f1.mood: Punchwheel's Patter — a cheeky music-hall march with brass pah-stabs and a slide-trombone laugh at every phrase end.

oldlight-f2.where: The Old Light, floor 2 — The Late Laugh (a stage whose audience laughs a beat late)
oldlight-f2.mood: The Late Laugh — the same march with a lazy swing; every laugh arrives a beat after the joke.

oldlight-f3.where: The Old Light, floor 3 — Intermission (the tea-urn floor, a rest point)
oldlight-f3.mood: Intermission — a swung tea-room lounge tune; the urn whistles and the flute scoops into its long notes.

oldlight-f4.where: The Old Light, floor 4 — The Backwards Inn (a mirror maze, everything reversed)
oldlight-f4.mood: The Backwards Inn — the march turned inside out: the tune walks in the tuba while the oom-pah flips to the top.

oldlight-f5.where: The Old Light, floor 5 — The Gallery of Confident Facts (wrong captions, a waxed floor, banana skins)
oldlight-f5.mood: Confident Facts — a pompous brass fanfare that keeps landing on proudly wrong notes.

oldlight-f6.where: The Old Light, floor 6 — The One Joke (the same joke on repeat; the tower starting to come apart)
oldlight-f6.mood: The One Joke — the march stuck like a broken record: skipping, warping, wheezing round and round the same bar.

oldlight-f7.where: The Old Light, top — The Winding Room (Mr. Punchwheel, the great joke-drum, flying apart)
oldlight-f7.mood: The Winding Room — the joke machine at full delirium: the march in every key at once, lurching, melting, and snapping back.

pale-vault-glacier-a.where: Pale Vault Glacier (the aurora-lit ice town outdoors); returns after meeting Warden Còr and after the Aurora-watch vigil
pale-vault-glacier-a.mood: Aurora Vault — glacial, shimmering, lonely-beautiful; the stillest, most tender place in the north, suspended and never quite resolving.

pale-vault-glacier-b.mood: Snow-Hushed Town — a small warm song against the cold: people and lanterns indoors, melancholy and intimate, hope that is fragile.

pale-vault-glacier-c.where: The Pale Vault Undercroft + the Hourfold (the deep-ice site of the Still Hour); returns after Noctilune is caught
pale-vault-glacier-c.mood: Glasslight — the glacier as a lush luminous reverie: ringing suspended chords, bell entries blooming and dissolving into echo; vast, sacred, still.

pearlmoor-blessing.where: The Tide-blessing festival on Pearlmoor Quay (the cutscene after the Tide Gleam is relit)
pearlmoor-blessing.mood: The going-out song — lantern boats on moonlit water; the quay waltz turned into a cool, glowing, sure ceremony.

pearlmoor-quay-a.where: Pearlmoor Quay — the harbour town itself, home of the Tide Lumenary
pearlmoor-quay-a.mood: A waltz on wet boardwalks under a cyan moon — the lamplit harbour at night, nets mended, boats rocking, the whole quay humming along.

pearlmoor-quay-b.where: Pearlmoor's outskirts — the breakwater (the Causeway Bell), the allotment hill and Pearlmoor Point
pearlmoor-quay-b.mood: Low tide, lantern strings — the quay waltz late and quiet, a lonely-but-cosy sway on the edge of town.

pearlmoor-quay-c.where: The top of the Old Light on Pearlmoor Point — the joke-tower's punchline lantern room and its celebratory send-off
pearlmoor-quay-c.mood: Festival of the floating lights — the quay waltz in its happiest dress, quick, ornamented and playful.

penumbra-ring-a.where: Penumbra Ring + Starwell (the last dark before the Umbral Spire)
penumbra-ring-a.mood: Wall of Ink: the last dark, crossed on starlight; a held breath, your heartbeat and one lonely lamp-note, hope leaking in at the edges.

rimeway.where: The Rimeway (the star-tenders' high road over the frost col above the Pale Vault, a line of dead rime-lamps)
rimeway.mood: Lonely and grand: wind over a high frost col, a line of dead rime-lamps marching into the cold, the glacier far below.

saltreach-fen-a.where: Saltreach Fen I (the open reed marsh east of Pearlmoor)
saltreach-fen-a.mood: A slow drift through reed shallows — a breathy woodwind wanders and the lapping water answers; melancholy, never sad.

saltreach-fen-b.where: Saltreach Fen II (the deep channels and lantern-reeds, past the Tidecall boundary)
saltreach-fen-b.mood: The same fen lonelier and further in — a boat-rocking 6/8 through bone-white mist, one questioning phrase at a time.

saltreach-fen-c.where: Sunkbell Shallows (the flooded-shrine spur off Fen II, reached by Tidecall)
saltreach-fen-c.mood: The fen relit — open water, a drowned shrine bell ringing under the ripples, a warmer lilting waltz you've earned.

shop-counter.where: Every shop — the Tinderwick General Store, the Pearlmoor Chandlery, the Galehigh Kite-Maker's and every counter after
shop-counter.mood: The Counter Bell — a bouncy little shop tune with a doorbell for a hook; browse as long as you like.

stillwater.where: Stillwater, the Hollowing's village north of the Coldfog marshes: shuttered lamps, soft voices, kin asleep under grey blankets
stillwater.mood: A hush-hymn: a music-box with a felt damper, sung softly by tired, kind people who believe the dark is mercy.

sting-hour.where: The Three Hours' threshold — the moment an Hour is met, just before its set-piece battle
sting-hour.mood: A single great bell tolls the hour: deep, awed, with a long shimmering tail.

sunken-solarium-a.where: Sunken Solarium (the drowned sun-garden ruin, West) + the Old Light tower floors (Pearlmoor)
sunken-solarium-a.mood: Remembered Summer: stored daylight glowing up through the water - warm, nostalgic, everything in the past tense; the first real warmth since the south.

sunken-solarium-b.where: Sunken Solarium Lumenary (Lucan Pyre's flooded stage hall) + the Last-Warm-Day festival bed
sunken-solarium-b.mood: Drowned Halls: the same sun-garden with the water winning - cooler, lonelier, a summer theme recoloured into its relative minor; bittersweet warmth spent knowing it fades.

sunken-solarium-c.where: The Unrisen Stair (Three Hours site III, the Dawn-that-waited) + after its catch + the Old Light's 5th floor
sunken-solarium-c.mood: Sunsketch Bloom: the relit reading - daylight surging back into the drowned garden, the motif sung twice and the second time brighter; the score reaching toward dawn.

sunvault-climb-a.where: Sunvault Climb I & II (golden vine terraces up to Nightreach) + the Sunfall vigil site
sunvault-climb-a.mood: Vines to the Sky: warm, ascending, hopeful - every phrase climbs like the terraces; the sunniest route in the West.

sunvault-climb-c.where: Helia Vault (the Sunsketch puzzle reliquary off Sunvault Climb II)
sunvault-climb-c.mood: First Light at the Top: Solar warmth meets the first true starlight - the climbing hook at its highest, doubled in bells, inside a sunlit reliquary of blooms and sun-mirrors.

tinderwick-a.mood: The hometown lullaby — lanterns in the dark, cosy and a little homesick. The source of the Vesper motif.

tinderwick-b.where: The apprentice's house in Tinderwick (Gran's home, the hometown lullaby indoors)
tinderwick-b.mood: Embers banked low — the hometown lullaby gone indoors at night, a 6/8 sway by the coals, homesick and safe.

tinderwick-c.where: Duskapple Orchard once the first Gleam is relit — the shoots come up in the burn
tinderwick-c.mood: First light on the water — the hometown tune's rising half asked under orchard boughs, Lydian wonder with a thread of mystery.

title.mood: The calling card: a lone lantern-tune in the dark explodes into a heroic minor adventure anthem; the Long Dusk, and the journey rising against it.

umbral-spire-a.where: Umbral Spire summit (the Great Null, Warden Còr, the Keystar)
umbral-spire-a.mood: Crown of Null: the summit under the Keystar; grave, sorrowful grandeur and driving resolve, the hometown motif boomed in minor and promised its major.

umbral-spire-b.where: Umbral Spire ascent (gatehouse, null-works, high gallery)
umbral-spire-b.mood: The Black Ascent: the climb through the dead Lumenary, null-lanterns leaking anti-light; relentless minor drive, all tension and no release.

umbral-spire-c.where: Umbral Spire summit, the Keystar relight cutscene
umbral-spire-c.mood: First True Dawn: the Keystar catches and the whole sky lights; the hometown motif stated whole in radiant major, triumphant with a tear in it.

undertide.where: The Undertide, the sea-caves under the Farlamp Isles: dark tidal channels, dripping water, tide-bells ringing far away
undertide.mood: A sea-cave in the deep: drips, distant bells, the isles' hymn broken into low fragments.

vesper-crossroads-a.where: Vesper Crossroads — the Lanternway hub where the five lit lanes meet (waystone, waystation inn, fingerpost)
vesper-crossroads-a.mood: The Signpost Tune — all roads meet here: a road-folk waystation band strikes up the home tune, lute, reed and tambourine on the front porch of the world.

wickrun.where: The Wick-Run (the old wax-carters' chute down the dark mountain's west flank, raced by the Runners)
wickrun.mood: Reckless and exhilarating: runner-wheels screaming down a graded chute in the dark, lamps whipping past, the air over the jumps.

windward-stair-a.where: Windward Stair I & II (the switchback mountain route) + the Wind-Eye and Thunderroost spurs
windward-stair-a.mood: The Long Climb — airy, building, breath-quickening; each phrase re-launches a step higher so the loop feels like ascent.
